event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event. Format: EVT-<number> or UUID.

case_id.description: The investigation case this event belongs to.

timestamp_end.description: When the event ended (UTC, ISO 8601). Null for instantaneous events.

actor_id.description: The entity that performed the action (employee ID, username, camera zone). Null if unknown.

action.description: The type of activity observed from the controlled vocabulary.

object_id.description: The object acted upon (file ID, device ID, door ID). Null if not applicable.

location_id.description: Physical or logical location (room, network segment, server). Null if unknown.

source_type.description: The modality/source that produced this event.

source_id.description: The specific evidence record this event was extracted from (links to evidence table).

confidence.description: Confidence in the event extraction, from 0.0 (low) to 1.0 (high).
